Window = Hanning is a standard way to prevent high frequency data processing noise, removes sharp leading and trailing sample edges. Think of the sound coming on slowly and then growing to it's maximum amplitude and then fading away instead of coming on instantly at its full amplitude and then shutting off. But this is over the FFT sample so all that happens in less than 1/20th of a second.

FFT size = 2048 says that they divided the data into set of 2048 points to analyze it. In this case that is just less than a 20th of a second per fft (2048/44100=0.0464 seconds).

The left axis of the graph is in dB, probably dBa, which is a standard measure of sound pressure.
